parameters.name: AppKey
parameters.description: The key of the application that is used to make an API call.

parameters.name: NewAppKey
parameters.description: The new AppKey that you set must be globally unique.

parameters.name: NewAppSecret
parameters.description: The new key of the application. To improve compatibility, we recommend that you use other parameters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi reset-app-secret --app-key 60030986 --new-app-key testAppKey --new-app-secret test000 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi ResetAppSecret --region cn-hangzhou --NewAppKey testAppKey --AppKey 60030986 --NewAppSecret test000
